title: Task params for oedis.handler.smb.upload
description: Configuration for uploading files from the task inbox to an SMB share.

connection.description: SMB connection settings used to resolve the UNC share root and optional credentials.

unc.description: UNC root path for the SMB share, for example \\FS01\FinanceShare or \\FS01\FinanceShare\Outbound\CORRA.

auth.description: Optional SMB credentials passed to register_session().

requests.description: List of SMB upload instructions. Each item describes one local source selection and how matched files should be copied to the SMB destination.

dst_dir.description: Remote destination directory relative to connection.unc. Leave empty to upload directly into the UNC root.

src_dir.description: Source directory under ctx.inbox. Must be a relative local path when provided.

include.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to include. Matching is attempted against both the file name and the path relative to src_dir. Prefer recursive=true with patterns like '*.csv' instead of '**/*.csv'.

exclude.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. Matching is attempted against both the file name and the path relative to src_dir.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir. When false, only files directly under src_dir are considered.

delete_source_file.description: When true, delete the local source file after a successful upload and remote size validation.
